aiSummary: In October 2026, Windows led operating systems (combined) (desktop) in Europe at 77.06% (market share of tracked page views / usage). OS X ranked second at 10.4%, followed by macOS at 6.2%.

faqs.question: Which item leads operating systems (combined) (desktop) in Europe?
faqs.answer: Windows leads at 77.06% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/os-market-share/desktop/europe.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for operating systems (combined) (desktop) in Europe?
faqs.answer: Windows (77.06%), OS X (10.4%), macOS (6.2%) in October 2026.
